observations.project_name: Lugo Substation Install new 500 kV CBs for AA Banks
observations.note: July 2026: The first Lugo AA Bank will be replaced in 2030 following the completion of the Lugo 3AA Bank in 2029. Due to schedule work at Lugo in 2031 and the scheduled delivery date for the 500kV CB's for the remaining Lugo 3AA Bank, the completion date for the 2nd AA Bank was moved to 2032. However, SCE is currently evaulating the possibility of completion both AA Banks by the end of 2030 if the delivery date for the 2nd set of 500kV CB's are delivered at an earlier date.
